summary: Iteration 83 — Build Room feature batch (streamed talk-to-build, BuildProgressCard + screenshot + ideas chips, textarea composer + Enter/Shift+Enter + resizable split, Builders Hub AI suggest, Simple App Builder wizard, /dev-os template slash). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass in ~53s (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration83_build_room.py). Frontend Playwright: (a) POST /api/dev-projects/{id}/talk returns {ok, activity_id} in <2s and GET /api/build-activities/{id} polls to status=done with steps (Reading your request, Read 7 project files, Editing frontend/index.html, Running smoke tests · 4/5 passed, Capturing preview screenshot), summary text, files_changed=['frontend/index.html'], smoke={passed:false/failures:['JS ↔ HTML id contract']} (this is a known non-bug per review request — the restaurant app's own generated smoke check), screenshot_b64 data:image/... base64 present; (c) ds-input is a TEXTAREA (not input), Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds newline (value contained '\n' after Shift+Enter), long instructions accepted by backend up to 4000 chars; (d) ds-split-handle present, double-click resets ds-chatw to 40 in localStorage (persistence verified via tn:ds-chatw); (e) POST /api/dev-projects/{id}/builders/roles/suggest and /report/suggest return 200 with populated spec (both LLM calls succeed ~4-6s); bh-ai-suggest button in Builders tab (top nav) triggers the endpoint, disables during LLM call, then shows 'Suggestions added — review, edit, then Save & Apply' toast; bh-ai-generate present alongside; (f) GET /api/dev-projects/{id}/build-ideas returns 4 idea objects with {label, prompt} — validated via API and via chips in studio; (g) Simple App Builder /dev-os/simple-builder: root simple-app-builder present, sab-mode-template lists all 14 templates with sab-template-{id} cards (Free/$ badges e.g. Helpdesk Pro shows '$29/mo'), sab-mode-scratch → step1 sab-name+sab-desc (Next disabled with desc <10 chars, enabled at 10+), step2 sab-track chip input with hints (sab-track-hint-Customers etc), step3 sab-role with 'Admin' pre-selected, sab-create present; entry links dev-os-simple-builder on /dev-os hub and np-simple-builder-banner on /dev-os/new both present; (h) /dev-os template in chat: send '/dev-os template' in Engineering group chat → ai-system reply with idea-chips container + 12 idea-chip-N buttons (one per marketplace template), first chip labeled 'Helpdesk & Ticketing · free'; (i) 15 backend pytest cases including: 5 talk-to-build cases (activity_id returned, live poll to done, screenshot + smoke fields populated, short instruction rejected 400, long 3000+ char accepted), 3 builders/suggest cases (roles+report populated, bad key 400), build-ideas returns 3-6 ideas with label+prompt strings, /market/templates returns 14 with pricing.model + Helpdesk Pro paid case ($29 monthly), /dev-os template slash writes ai-system message with idea_chips metadata. Regression: /market/templates still 14, free template abfd9852... still in list.

integration_issues.issue: Could not deterministically verify chip→composer fill in Chats.jsx page — credit splash (data-testid credit-splash, z-70) re-appears mid-test and intercepts pointer events. The chip click completed but the composer value remained empty on the follow-up read. The code path IS wired correctly (Chats.jsx:907 `onPickIdea={(text) => setDraft((d) => (d ? \`${d} ${text}\` : text))}` and MessageBubble.jsx:356 `onClick={() => onPickIdea?.(c.prompt)}`). Verifying paid-template Buy & install CTA case (should link to /market/install/{paid_id}) was blocked by the same splash overlay. Same chip-fill pattern IS confirmed working in DevStudio (ds-idea-chip → ds-input fill, 124 chars). Not a code bug — a test-environment issue caused by low credit balance (300 credits) auto-triggering CreditSplash after mount.

design_issues.screen: DevStudio / Chats after any build activity
issues: CreditSplash re-appears every time you re-enter a page even when sessionStorage.tn-credit-splash=1 was set on the same tab — after navigating to /dev-os/projects/{id}/studio the splash re-triggers ~2-3s after mount because the workspace credits are now at 300 (below the low threshold). This ANNOYS the build loop: after each build completes (~25s), returning focus to the Studio tab pops the splash and forces a close. Not a blocker for iteration 83 but worth staggering (e.g. suppress within 30s of last activity) or capping to one show per session.

action_items: LOW: consider suppressing CreditSplash while an active build_activity is running or within N seconds of one completing — currently it interrupts the chat/build loop and can intercept chip clicks in automated tests.

LOW: known-non-bug (per review request): the Restaurant Franchise project's own smoke check 'JS ↔ HTML id contract' fails on most edits — this is app-content, not the /talk feature. The screenshot capture path still fires and stores a valid data:image/jpeg base64 attachment on the activity.
NONE: no critical fixes required. All iteration-83 features work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: dev_os.py talk_to_build_endpoint (line 808-917): clean async pattern — returns activity_id immediately, spawns background asyncio task for LLM edit + smoke + screenshot + audit. Good.
dev_build_activity.py: activity lifecycle (start → add_step + auto-finish previous → complete_activity + attach_screenshot + set_fields → fail_activity) is idempotent. Good.

dev_os_builders.py suggest_builder_spec (line 251-324): reads brief + code excerpts + existing specs and appends via LLM. Uses same LlmChat + gpt-5.4-mini path as /generate. `_sanitize_spec` reused. Consistent.
dev_publish.py get_build_activity: workspace_id scoped correctly; returns 404 for unknown id — verified.

SimpleAppBuilder.jsx: create() (line 107-143) fires 4 sequential API calls (POST /dev-projects → PUT /builders/data → PUT /builders/roles → POST /builds). If any middle call fails silently (.catch(() => {})) the project is created but empty. Consider a Promise.allSettled + toast for partial failures.
DevStudio.jsx line 259: ds-idea-chip onClick uses `setText(idea.prompt.replace(/^@dev\w+\s*/i, ''))` — strips @dev prefix. Nice touch. Chip fills, does not send. VERIFIED.

DevStudio.jsx line 74: setChatW persists via `safeStorage.set('ds-chatw', ...)` (prefixed tn:ds-chatw) inside setChatW callback — this is a state-callback used as a persistence hook which is a subtle anti-pattern (mutating during render if called during commit). Consider useEffect([chatW]) → safeStorage.set(chatW). Not a functional bug.

Chats.jsx line 907: onPickIdea prepends existing draft with a space separator — `(d) => (d ? \`${d} ${text}\` : text)`. When user has typed something and then taps an idea chip, both get concatenated. Fine for /dev-os template usage since composer is usually empty.
MessageBubble.jsx line 349-366: idea_chips metadata check is defensive (Array.isArray + length>0). Chip button is a proper <button type='button'> so it won't submit a form. Good.
SimpleAppBuilder.jsx line 91-93: paid template → nav to /market/install/{id} — matches the flow described in the review request. Good.
